Task: Pick up the four tennis balls one at a time and place each into the green basket. model.pt contains evaluation weights. The accompanying configuration, normalization statistics, dependency snapshot and code archive describe this run.

sources.snippet: Extract code.zip and install its Long-WAM checkout. Use longwam.inference.load_run_config and load_model with this repository's explicit model.pt and expected_step=5000. Adapt SIP model/statistics/cache paths to your evaluation machine. Wan2.2 VAE, UMT5 text encoder and tokenizer assets are required separately.
